dct_description_sm:
The Census 2006 Population and Dwelling Counts (PDC) tables show the distribution of population and dwellings in Canada by various geographic areas:

  • Canada
  • Provinces
  • Territories
  • Economic Regions
  • Census Divisions
  • Census Consolidated Subdivisions
  • Census Subdivisions
  • Municipalities
  • Designated Places
  • Federal Electoral Districts - 2003 Representation Order
  • Census Metropolitan Areas
  • Census Agglomerations
  • Census Tracts
  • Dissemination Areas
  • Dissemination Blocks
  • Forward Sortation Areas
  • Urban Areas
  • Rural Areas
  • Statistical Area Classifications

Data are also provided for land area and population density. Geographic boundaries are those in effect on January 1, 2006.
dct_rights_sm: This dataset is made available with limited information on how it can be used. You may wish to communicate with the Contact(s) specified before use.
